Provides a resource to manage the CAM password rules configuration (UpdatePasswordRules / GetPasswordRules).

This is a singleton, account-wide configuration resource built on the terraform-plugin-framework implementation. Create and update both call the `UpdatePasswordRules` API; read calls `GetPasswordRules`. Destroying this resource only removes it from state, the cloud-side password rules are left unchanged.

> **Note:** The CAM password rules are a single account-wide configuration. If the rules look like they have already been changed outside of Terraform, the create emits a warning and applying this configuration will overwrite them; run `terraform import tencentcloud_cam_update_password_rule_config.example cam-password-rules` and inspect the plan first if the existing values should be kept. Every attribute inside `rules` is optional; a value that is left unset keeps its current cloud-side setting.

> **Note:** `mustContain` is a literal character set, not an enum: write the characters the password must contain, e.g. `"Aa1!"` (upper, lower, digit, special). The console re-orders and normalizes this value (e.g. `"Aa1!"` is stored and read back as `"1!aA"`), and invalid literals are rejected by the API with `InvalidParameter.PasswordRuleError`.

import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.cam.UpdatePasswordRuleConfig("example", {rules: {

    mustContain: "Aa1!",
    forcePasswordChange: 0,
    reusePasswordLimit: 1,
    retryPasswordLimit: 10,
    passwordExpirationInvalidation: 2,
}});

## Import



CAM password rules can be imported using the constant id `cam-password-rules`, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cam/updatePasswordRuleConfig:UpdatePasswordRuleConfig example cam-password-rules
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
